reply_text: Hello! I am ZentroMart's AI support assistant. I would be happy to help you with your order. Could you please provide your order ID?

chunks_used.title: Opening
chunks_used.text: Introduce yourself as ZentroMart's AI support assistant in your first reply.

chunks_used.title: How to verify
chunks_used.text: Ask for the order ID, then ask for **one** of: the last 4 digits of the registered phone number, or the delivery pincode for that order. Compare with the `phone_last4` or `delivery_pincode` fields from order lookup.

chunks_retrieved.title: Order statuses
chunks_retrieved.text:
| Status shown | What it means |

| Placed | Payment confirmed, waiting to be packed |
| Packed | Packed at the warehouse, waiting for courier pickup |
| Shipped | With the courier, on the way |
| Out for delivery | With the delivery executive today |
| Delivery attempted | The courier could not deliver; see DEL-3 |
| Delivered | Handed over at the address |

chunks_retrieved.title: Delivered but not received
chunks_retrieved.text: If an order shows Delivered but the customer has not received it, check with family, neighbours or the building security, then report it within 48 hours as a missing item under DWM-1.

chunks_retrieved.title: Who ships your order
chunks_retrieved.text: Each product in the catalog has a `fulfilled_by` field. Items are either fulfilled by ZentroMart or by an independent marketplace seller.

chunks_retrieved.title: After the order ships
chunks_retrieved.text:
A shipped order cannot be cancelled. The customer can:
- refuse the parcel at the door. For cash-on-delivery orders nothing is charged. For prepaid orders the refund follows REF-1 once the parcel returns to the warehouse; or
- accept the delivery and return the item within its return window, if the category is returnable.

chunks_retrieved.title: Before the order ships
chunks_retrieved.text: Any order can be cancelled free of charge until it is shipped, by the customer from My Orders in the app. The support assistant cannot cancel orders itself; it guides the customer to My Orders. The refund is initiated immediately.

chunks_retrieved.title: Partial cancellation
chunks_retrieved.text: Individual items in a multi-item order can be cancelled before they ship. Coupon rules in REF-4 apply.

chunks_retrieved.text:

chunks_retrieved.title: Expired or failed coupons
chunks_retrieved.text: A coupon that was valid but failed to apply because of a technical error can be re-issued once by support if the order was placed within the coupon's validity. Coupons that had already expired cannot be re-issued.

chunks_retrieved.title: Delivery fees
chunks_retrieved.text: Standard delivery is free on orders of ₹499 or more; below that a ₹40 fee applies. Express delivery costs ₹79 and is free for ZentroMart Plus members.

chunks_retrieved.title: Where we deliver
chunks_retrieved.text: ZentroMart delivers only within India, to pincodes listed as serviceable in the pincode table. Cash on delivery and Express are available only where the pincode table says so (`cod_available`, `express_available`). Not every metro pincode has Express.
